calls.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: one high-fidelity Remilo Android UI design-evaluation screenshot, derived from supplied approved references.
Do not redesign the app. The frozen R10 specification is source of truth. Image 1 is the matching R3 atmosphere/appearance STYLE AND COLOR reference; image 2 if provided is the accepted secondary-screen component style reference only. Replace the homepage/reference content with the requested R10 UI.
Framing: one flat full-screen Android app screenshot, portrait 9:20 ratio, preferably same 841x1870 raster as the reference; logical viewport 360x800 dp. No phone frame, perspective, comparison board, labels outside UI, marketing title, shadows around a phone, or poster. All screens share the same product typography (Roboto-like), metrics, icon stroke/family and component anatomy.
Android system status 2:00 and standard system icons at top; gesture bar at bottom. Below status use compact approximately 96dp opening total: 56dp toolbar with neutral Back + page title, then ~40dp shallow matching lake/mountains/conifer illustration crop. Scene and title must not consume one quarter of screen. Keep scene identity faithful to R3, but reduce it to the same shared secondary crop. No repeated oversized Remilo branding or invented slogan.
Use exactly the corresponding scene/color family: Sunrise Light warm off-white/white/burnt-orange action; Sunrise Dark SOFT charcoal/raised charcoal/pale-apricot action with dark text. Sky Light pale cool-blue/white/blue; Sky Dark SOFT blue-slate/raised blue-slate/pale-sky-blue action with dark text and DAYTIME CLOUDS. Evening Light pale rose/white/muted plum; Evening Dark SOFT plum-charcoal/raised plum/pale-rose action with dark text and SUNSET SUN. Night Light icy-blue/white/deep-blue action, crescent/stars artwork; Night Dark SOFT navy-slate/raised navy/periwinkle action with dark text. Never independent pure black. Match shared canvas AND elevated surfaces.
Reading planes opaque. Main titles/values neutral on-surface; labels/helper text neutral muted high contrast, never tint all metadata by atmosphere. Ordinary upload/download/Back/info/chevrons/refresh glyphs neutral, consistent line icon family. Color only actual primary/selected controls or labeled semantic feedback; no decorative colored list icons.
Metrics: 16dp horizontal gutters and rounded corners, 16sp body, 14sp supporting text, >=48dp targets, 56dp prominent action. No inflated title typography, no tiny helper text, no forced font shrinking. Long titles/notes wrap and grow. Realistic layout with content continuing below the viewport; do not squeeze entire page inventory into one screen.
No root tab bar or FAB on these secondary pages. No app keyboard/input unless specified (none in R10). OS chooser/share sheet is not shown in these captures; draw requested app state before/after handoff. No cloud, overwrite, fake filename, exact timing absent from preview, new Settings categories, safety badge/health grade or unsupported buttons.
If a Restore preview exists, one fixed bottom footer: stacked full-width filled primary action, then outlined secondary Cancel preview; both readable and inset-safe. Scroll ends above the measured footer; zero overlap with body. Busy/unconfirmed feedback immediately above action buttons in the same reserved footer area, readable choices frozen in body. No Save or toolbar Restore duplicate.
Copy must be verbatim as supplied. Treat requested content as realistic product data. Specification corrections take priority over incidental reference-image coloring.
SCREEN R10-01: Settings Data and Help, Sunrise Light. This is the existing Settings page scrolled to Data and Help (earlier categories above, do not draw them). Use Image 1 matching Sunrise Light for scene/colors; Image 2 for secondary Settings component anatomy. Image 2 has unrelated Alarms content; replace it entirely with these Data/Help sections.
Toolbar Back + "Settings". Compact sunrise crop. Warm off-white canvas, white grouped cards, neutral line icons in quiet neutral rounded tiles.
Below: section heading "Data". One white grouped card, two approximately 64dp rows: neutral upload icon with title "Export backup" (action, no chevron required), neutral download icon with title "Restore backup" and chevron (navigation). Modest separators.
Below card, supporting copy at 14sp, verbatim and wrapped: "Backups include lists and reminders, except one-off reminders in Trash. Repeating deletion exclusions are kept." Then "Backups include reminder titles and notes."
Next section heading "Help". White grouped card: neutral info icon, "Diagnostics", chevron. Next informational row "Remilo" with supporting value "0.4.0 · Android".
The layout is comfortably dense but natural: 16dp gutters, headings around20sp, values16sp, helpers14sp. Fit Data + Help in this viewport without giant whitespace between sections. Remaining canvas naturally empty below; no invented illustration there, no extra actions or motivational copy. Nothing is selected; do not tint upload/download/info icons orange just because tappable. No bottom buttons/root tabs/Save. Standard Android gesture bar.

observations: The content, neutral glyphs and backup disclosure match the requested Settings Data/Help state.
The scenic opening is taller and the lower blank space more generous than the compact layout target.
corrections: Implement the shared 96 dp opening below status and 16/14 sp type, rather than copying raster heights or blank spacing.
Remilo/version is informational; no action or chevron is required. All ordinary glyphs share neutral roles.
